name: iHypnosis: Inspiring Journeys
summary:
iHypnosis: Inspiring Journeys opens in a cinematic, comfort-first sanctuary and pairs seven immersive 360° locations with six original motivational speeches. First choose a setting, then choose any narration to create your own reflective journey. The original video audio is muted, and a shorter scene loops gently until the selected speech ends.

Visit a woodland sunrise, a sunset, the Czech waterside, a tranquil sea, Attali Monastery, a peaceful park, or the Canary Islands' ocean. Pause, restart, recenter,
